restaurantName: Gong Zhou · Ba Shu Wei Yuan
address: No. 6, 64 Junlong Street, Jinjiang, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: Gong Zhou was the ancient name of Chongqing, the home municipality of the owner and kitchen team. Since opening in a residential area next to Taikoo-li shopping hub in 1998, it has kept its fans coming back for its Chongqing dishes, such as auspicious home-style fish – blanched grass carp dressed in a tangy sauce made with spicy bean sauce, pickled chilli and ginger.
